summary: Preinstall hook downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundle unrelated to package purpose
details: Package advertises itself as an ESLint plugin (~45-line dist/index.js) but its package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads a platform-specific Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/, extracts it, chmods it executable, and invokes it against math_init.js — a 727KB heavily obfuscated Bun-compiled bundle shipped in the tarball. math_init.js uses obfuscator.io-style scrambled string-array rotation (`WV8StW`/`n7gIxM`), hex-named identifiers, and contains no readable strings. The ESLint rule at dist/index.js does not reference either setup.mjs or math_init.js, and has no functional need for the Bun runtime or the shipped payload. On `npm install`, this executes an opaque payload under an alternate runtime on the installer's build machine. The package version (12.8.19) is anomalously high for a small plugin, consistent with a compromised-publisher republish against the @servicetitan scope.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
